equity.level_reason: Rates are reported by urbanization level (rurality) and sex and described (higher in rural areas), but values are only set side by side with no computed contrast and no disparity framing.

level_alternative.reason: Urbanization could be read as geography of county of residence rather than social position, leaving only sex results.

equity.equity_measurement: Rurality is assigned from county of residence via the NCHS six-level urban-rural scheme; crude (not age-adjusted) rates.

ev.q: the death rate increased from 0.11 per 100,000 for those residing in large central metro areas, to 0.40 for those in noncore (rural) areas

notes: Sex is compared within each urbanization level, but only side by side with no computed contrast, so depth is kept at comparison. Six urbanization levels inferred from the NCHS scheme and figure; only four are named in the text.
view_issues: Claims of higher and lowest rates rest on the figure with 95% CI error bars; no test or overlap rule is stated.
